facts.fact: SMART Zambia Institute, with the Ministry of Health and IHM Southern Africa, launched a pilot rollout of the SmartCare 2.0 Hospital Edition electronic health record system at Ndola Teaching Hospital on 27 April 2026.
SmartCare 2.0 Hospital Edition went live as a pilot at one facility, Ndola Teaching Hospital, on 27 April 2026.
As of 27 April 2026 SmartCare 2.0 is a pilot at Ndola Teaching Hospital only; the document names no primary clinic using it.

Government Chief Technology Officer Kasali Musenge said at the 27 April 2026 launch that SmartCare 2.0 is locally developed and owned; it was launched by SMART Zambia Institute with the Ministry of Health and IHM Southern Africa.

systems.owner: SMART Zambia Institute with the Ministry of Health and IHM Southern Africa
